verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents explicit mechanisms for issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials to AI agents: agents calling first-party APIs on a user's behalf via OAuth 2.0 to prevent broad unrestricted access (auth0-docs-16), a Token Vault that manages third-party API tokens without exposing raw credentials (auth0-docs-17/30), unique per-agent identities for API/MCP access (auth0-docs-20), and CIBA-based step-up approval for sensitive operations (auth0-docs-18/31). Client Credentials flow (M2M, docs-8/25) and RBAC (docs-7/39/45) further support fine-grained scoping. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that agent-issued tokens are actually least-privilege in practice, and more concrete documentation of scope-configuration granularity specifically for agent credentials.
